# Lifecycle Requirements Checklist: Temporary Room Lifecycle

**Purpose**: PR-review checklist for the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of temporary-room lifecycle requirements.
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements specified for starting exactly one inactivity period when a recognized managed room first becomes empty? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements specified for every lifecycle outcome at expiry: occupied, empty, externally missing, unavailable, and failed deletion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010–013, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification define association cleanup for both successful automatic deletion and observed external deletion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the timeout default, unit, inclusive range, per-server scope, and invalid-value outcome all documented as one configuration contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–008, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the requirements explicit that only recognized managed temporary rooms are lifecycle candidates and that trigger, category, and unrelated channels are excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK006 Is “continuously empty” unambiguous about the start point, interruption by any join, reset behavior, and no carry-over between empty periods? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001–003, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the final pre-deletion emptiness requirement clear enough to distinguish an occupied room from a stale or unavailable room? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the 15-minute failed-deletion retry policy clear about its precondition, retry cadence, cancellation on activity, and final room-state check? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the stale-association requirements consistent with the separate rule that a failed move alone is not evidence a room is missing? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012–013, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK010 Are “managed temporary room,” “active-room association,” “inactivity period,” and “stale association” used consistently across stories, requirements, and entities? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]

## Acceptance Criteria and Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are primary create-to-empty-to-expiry-to-delete acceptance scenarios defined with observable association-cleanup outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Are alternate rejoin-before-expiry and later-empty-again scenarios defined so the old period cannot cause deletion? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are duplicate, delayed, and concurrent activity scenarios specified with an objective “one effective period/no intentional occupied deletion” outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004–005, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are external deletion, missing/delayed notification, and creator recreation requirements complete without adding out-of-scope restart recovery? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, §FR-011–012, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK015 Are deletion-failure and move-failure recovery requirements distinct, including the expected association state after each? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-013]

## Edge Cases and Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are the requirements clear that every automatic deletion attempt, including a retry, must re-establish emptiness before deletion? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for unavailable Discord state so it is not silently treated as an empty or missing room? [Gap, Plan §Implementation Approach, Contract §Application Ports]
- [ ] CHK018 Are privacy-safe observability requirements specific about permitted bounded outcomes and prohibited tokens, raw events, identifiers, and provider error text? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Plan §Constraints, Contract §Observable Outcomes]
- [ ] CHK019 Can the measurable outcomes objectively demonstrate both safe non-deletion for occupied/unmanaged channels and lifecycle cleanup after continuous emptiness? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–004]
- [ ] CHK020 Are deterministic automated-coverage requirements explicit enough to rule out real default-duration waits and live Discord credentials in CI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §Assumptions]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Scope

- [ ] CHK021 Are the dependency assumptions for authoritative Discord room state and deletion notification documented with a fallback for delayed notification? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011–012, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the in-memory-only boundary consistent across timeout behavior, association cleanup, and all listed out-of-scope restart/offline recovery work? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Are documentation requirements precise enough to require a safe local test value without introducing production identifiers or credentials? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the stated test-layer requirements traceable to each critical lifecycle, resilience, stale-state, and configuration scenario? [Traceability, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Notes

- Focus: full lifecycle and resilience requirements.
- Depth: standard PR review.
- Audience: independent PR reviewers.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
